items.title: Jason Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2025
items.q: INTERVIEWER mentions John Coltrane in the context of sax players sounding like him; INTERVIEWEE responds with 'Um hum. Yeah.'

ctx.x: You make me think of, you’re talking about finding your own sound, and when we started this interview project back thirty years ago I was speaking with the older generation and a lot of them would say, “well everybody sounds the same now.” You know the sax players sound like either Charlie Parker or John Coltrane, and Sweets Edison was going on about how in his day you could recognize someone in one note, and he said this, he said, “We used to say we’d rather be the world’s worst originator than the world’s…
